documentation_collection.purpose: Local, unchanged review snapshots of selected PSF documentation and its license. The owner requested rapid reuse; these are technical references requiring age-appropriate teaching, not four completed computing courses.

pages.title: Brief Tour of the Standard Library

sources.title: Beginning and Intermediate Algebra
sources.creator: Tyler Wallace
sources.attribution: Tyler Wallace, Beginning and Intermediate Algebra, copyright 2010, ISBN 978-1-4583-7768-5; CC BY 3.0; unmodified review copy.
sources.use: Grade 9 M01–M36 selections; placement-based algebra support for later grades, not Geometry or a complete advanced-mathematics sequence.
sources.restrictions: Preserve the book's license and attribution. No solutions-manual, workbook, video or linked-asset acquisition. Review copying is not runtime promotion or training approval.

sources.title: The Odyssey
sources.creator: Homer; Samuel Butler, translator
sources.license: Underlying edition public domain in the USA; Gutenberg file terms retained
sources.attribution: Homer, The Odyssey, Samuel Butler translation; Project Gutenberg ebook 1727. Exact source file and notices retained.
sources.use: Existing Grade 9 Books I–XXIV sequence, with the current reading caps, excerpt route, naming guidance and adult previews.
sources.restrictions: US public-domain route only; local jurisdiction and paid redistribution/trademark conditions require review. Translator prefaces are not assigned as established historical facts. No recordings or illustrations.

sources.title: Oedipus Trilogy: Antigone selection
sources.creator: Sophocles; Francis Storr, translator
sources.license: Underlying edition public domain in the USA; Gutenberg file terms retained
sources.attribution: Sophocles, Oedipus Trilogy, Francis Storr translation; Project Gutenberg ebook 31. Assigned work: Antigone only.
sources.use: Grade 9 Antigone scenes and argument/authority analysis; not assignment of the complete trilogy.
sources.restrictions: Full source kept for provenance; only Antigone is selected. Adult preview of death, suicide and family conflict required. US rights, local jurisdiction and Gutenberg terms remain distinct.

sources.title: The Analects
sources.creator: Confucius; James Legge, translator
sources.license: Underlying edition public domain in the USA; Gutenberg file terms retained
sources.attribution: Confucius, The Analects, James Legge translation; Project Gutenberg ebook 3330.
sources.use: Existing Grade 9 short selections in Books I, II, IV, XII and XV; contextual comparative reading.
sources.restrictions: Do not reduce a living tradition to slogans or silently substitute a modern translation. US rights, local jurisdiction and Gutenberg terms require separate treatment.

sources.title: The Song Celestial / Bhagavad-Gita
sources.creator: Edwin Arnold, verse translator
sources.license: Underlying edition public domain in the USA; Gutenberg file terms retained
sources.attribution: The Bhagavad-Gita, Edwin Arnold verse translation, The Song Celestial; Project Gutenberg ebook 2388.
sources.use: Existing Grade 9 Chapters II–III comparative literature selections, taught in historical and literary context.
sources.restrictions: Victorian rendering, not a neutral representation of every Hindu interpretation. Comparative academics, not devotional participation. US rights, local jurisdiction and Gutenberg terms apply.

sources.title: The Aeneid
sources.creator: Virgil; John Dryden, translator
sources.license: Underlying edition public domain in the USA; Gutenberg file terms retained
sources.attribution: Virgil, The Aeneid, John Dryden translation; Project Gutenberg ebook 228.
sources.use: Existing Grade 9 Books I, II, IV, VI and XII selections; adult-supported reading and analytical writing.
sources.restrictions: Preview violence and difficult verse; preserve the excerpt/access route. No modern apparatus or recordings cleared. US rights, local jurisdiction and Gutenberg terms apply.

sources.title: Latin for Beginners
sources.creator: Benjamin L. D'Ooge
sources.license: Underlying edition public domain in the USA; Gutenberg file terms retained
sources.attribution: Benjamin L. D'Ooge, Latin for Beginners; Project Gutenberg ebook 18251.
sources.use: Existing Grade 9 grammar/topic pathway and later language reference where appropriate; not four complete language courses.
sources.restrictions: Exclude the unassigned cultural-superiority introductory essays from teaching. Preserve macrons and document pronunciation conventions. No images/audio; US rights, local jurisdiction and Gutenberg terms apply.

sources.title: World History: Cultures, States, and Societies to 1500
sources.creator: Berger, Israel, Miller, Parkinson, Reeves and Williams; University System of Georgia / University of North Georgia Press
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for specified original author prose; incorporated assets excluded
sources.attribution: World History: Cultures, States, and Societies to 1500, 2016, listed authors, USG/UNG Press; selected original prose under CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.use: Existing H01–H36 bounded author-prose selections; use the exact replacement register, not complete chapters.
sources.restrictions: Do not download and import the entire book as cleared content. Exclude figures, maps, captions, quotations, translations and separately credited assets. Any adapted CC BY-SA prose retains ShareAlike obligations; do not relicense it proprietary.
